Game Overview

Mini Springs is a arcade title where guide a plucky purple slime through compact, puzzle-laden levels in Mini Springs. With limited controls, bounce with precision via color-coded springs while dodging hazardous enemies and spikes. Test your reflexes and strategic timing to lead the slime to its new world, reaching the goal flag with finesse.
